article.title: Everyday phone call phrases
article.description: Answering: 'Hello, this is [name] speaking.' Asking to hold: 'Could you hold on a second?' Ending: 'Thanks for calling, talk soon!' Common mistake: 'I am [name]' on the phone sounds unnatural in English — 'This is [name]' is the standard phone convention.
article.content: Answering: 'Hello, this is [name] speaking.' Asking to hold: 'Could you hold on a second?' Ending: 'Thanks for calling, talk soon!' Common mistake: 'I am [name]' on the phone sounds unnatural in English — 'This is [name]' is the standard phone convention.

generated.caption:
Ever started a phone call with "I am [name]" and gotten a strange look? 😅 On the phone, we naturally say "This is [name] speaking."

For example: "Hello, this is Sarah speaking." Need someone to wait? Try "Could you hold on a second?" End your call politely with "Thanks for calling, talk soon!"

Save this for confident calls! Follow @EnglishVault for daily tips!
generated.script: Phone pe call uthate hi apna intro kaise dete ho? I am [name] bolte ho na? Rukko, English mein ye thoda unnatural sound karta hai. Jab aap phone par hote ho, the standard way to introduce yourself is, "Hello, this is [name] speaking." Yeah, "This is [name]". Iska matlab hai ki aap ho jo call par baat kar rahe ho. Aur agar kisi ko hold par rakhna ho toh bolo, "Could you hold on a second?" Simple! Aur call end karte time, bol sakte ho, "Thanks for calling, talk soon!" Toh ab yaad rakhna, phone pe "I am [name]" nahi, "This is [name] speaking" bolo. Aur baaki phrases se professional lago! Kaisa laga ye tip? Comment mein batao aur follow karo The English Vault ko for more!

slides.headlineRest: Is Unnatural on the Phone! Here's Why.
slides.body: When answering a phone call, it's crucial to sound natural and polite. In English, the standard and most natural way to identify yourself is by saying, 'Hello, this is [name] speaking.' It's a common mistake to say 'I am [name],' but this sounds unnatural and isn't typically used in phone conversations. Remember to use 'Could you hold on a second?' if you need a moment, and end your call with a friendly, 'Thanks for calling, talk soon!' Using these phrases will make your phone interactions smooth and professional.
slides.hindiSummary: फ़ोन पर खुद का परिचय देने के लिए 'Hello, this is [name] speaking' कहना सबसे स्वाभाविक तरीका है।
